title: Clean Yourself and Come to Me!
body:
Dastoor ya Sayyidee, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
La hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyi 'l-`Adheem.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!

SubhanAllah, Sultan Allah, Azeez Allah, Kareem Allah.
Nahnu `abeeduka ad-du`afa qawee d`afana bi ridaaka yaa Rabbana bi-jaahi nabiyyika 'l-kareem. Shukran
laka yaa Rabbana bi laa hadd wa laa nihaayah.
And we are giving our salutes, all praising, and all glory for You to Your most honored servant through Your
Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa’l-aakhireen min al-azal il al-abad. We are
also happy and proud to be from his nation, alhamdulillah.
We are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. It is a holy
order of heavens to say a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. We have been ordered to run away from
every dishonored action. Therefore we are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, Bismillahi 'rRahmaani 'r-Raheem. Whoever is asking to reach heavenly honors must use bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem for every movement, every action and for every effort. Everything that we are thinking about we
must say bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem because we are nothing. If Allah is sending us from heavenly

powers, we will be able to do everything that gives us honor. We are going to be able to send away evil and
devils because they are afraid when we are saying bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
We are now listening to what They are asking to teach us. The first thing we must try to learn, first teaching
and first learning that is the title of tonight’s association. We hope that it should be a mubarak, blessed
association. They are giving us something that we can digest not through our stomachs, but through our
understanding center.
O our master, O Sultan al-Awliya! You are responsible for everything on this planet! You are the commander
and your commands are reaching to you from heavenly levels to make this planet to run to its ghaya,
destination! O our master! We are weak through our physical being and also through our heavenly
understanding. Help us, help us! Help those people who are giving their attentions to hear what is going to be
said this night. SubhaanAllah.
New day, new provision, yes? Never bringing yesterday’s (spiritual) food to put out now, no. That which is
granted to deputies of the Lord of Heavens therefore is from heavenly attributes. If anyone visiting them,
some guests coming, they are trying to put ikraam, to make their hospitality always new. They are trying to
give their hospitality for their guest because it is a heavenly order; if a guest is coming to you, give to your
guest the best. For your guest, must be best one.
I am speaking now Shakespeare, English-understanding people! You may learn something, but I am learning
that for the guest, give best. Another, mashaa-Allah, Yaa Huu. I am going to be something, reaching for
Shakespeare, yes. He was a faarigh (to have time to spare) person, nothing to do except write. Shakespeare
was writing to make people to wake up because Allah Almighty giving to everyone a different quality. You
can’t find two-ones' understanding or names or their physical beings as well as their heavenly beings to be
same for both of them. Heavenly beings like a space full of different colors of stars. We are knowing only
seven colors as the main source for all colors. For everyone there is a special station through the heavens.
Their heavenly beings have a samaa, sky or space that as we are looking now to skies and seeing countless
stars same color, but they are same color and more: some of them a little bit less, some of them a little bit
more.

O People, try to learn! Don’t be lazy ones like lazy students. Try to be a real student for understanding the
secrets of Man and the universe, because everyone from Mankind has a special reaching (for) that space, but
our physical being looking and seeing the same colors, same spots. Our real being is our spiritual being, our
spirituality; everyone’s spirituality is different. When it is going to be different, going to appear this space on
our heads. You are knowing seven colors as their umm, mothers. The main root is growing up through the
seven colors and we are stopping on the seven colors, but our trees are never stopping; in every branch you
should find another color. If one of them appearing to our real being we are falling down, giving our living
power. What is living power, do you know? Our souls, living power spirituality. You can’t find two of them to
be the same and according to our spiritual being they are real and not imitated beings.
We are now on this planet and our lives is imitated, imitated beings. Our reality is according to our creation:
first level, second level, third level, fourth level, fifth level, sixth level, seventh level through seven heavenly
stations and levels. Mankind is going to be under that tajalli, manifestation. Therefore, everyone's looking
through their spirituality just appearing in this space with different colors. This manifestation that we are
looking and seeing, such a simple thing, it is going to be seen through darkness. But really it is appearing on
heavenly levels, appearing through lightenings and not through darkness. Their sky is not black. No black.
Your skies are never going to be the same as his skies or that one’s skies. Different colors to give our
spirituality something about heavenly stations. Through the seven stations which station, which level will be
for you, through that station an appearance will just come.
O People! What is here? A stable of animals, and we are living around the dirt of animals. This whole world is
full of dirtiness; everyone on it is making dirty, putting dirt on this planet. What are you going to understand?
You are running through animal dirt in this world. Everyone’s work is to put dirt on it. How we are going to
be happy? You are just surrounded everywhere, making your dirtiness and putting it there? Why are you
going to love dunya? You must clean your clothes, you must try to change. Dress in a clean dress and for
everyone clean dressing is just prepared in heavens. In heavens no dirtiness, dirtiness only on this planet. Wa
theeyaabaka fatahhir. (74:4)
Try to clean your real being from dirtiness. Small child 'til growing and keeping dirtiness to put in special
place, mums covering their bodies and keeping that dirtiness with that baby 'til taking it and cleaning and
using another.

Therefore, holy order, O people, wa theeyaabaka fatahhir. We are dressing you in a dress of humanity. Clean
it, then you will see and you will reach levels that no dirtiness, no ugliness, no darkness, no ignorance, no
trouble, and no sufferings. Everything (hardship is) because your body is running in dirtiness, but when we
are changing and cleaning, they are putting our real being according to our level, putting there nazheef, clean
ones. Therefore, prophets coming to teach people how they should be clean and their messengerhood only for
teaching the ways of cleanliness for Mankind. But small ones, when their mums running after them, they are
escaping and they are not happy to their clothes changed, but mums catching them and cleaning them and
dressing clean, taking inside. Heavens and our real being are looking after ourselves. When we are clean we
are going to reach our real stations on our levels: may be first level, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth or
seventh level. According to our being we are going to be taken up.
Therefore, Allah Almighty has ordered through His most beloved and most honored one (s) to say to his
nation, his tribe and to all Mankind, “O people, come and try to be clean ones. Clean yourself.” That is the
main point of messengerhood. They are running away saying, “No, we like it.” You like to eat also. Why are
you saying, “We like it?” That means you like to eat that also. They are so unhappy with prophets and are
running away and also attacking them or killing them. But no prophet was killed by those people; they were
quickly taken up and only their imitated beings remained on Earth. They cut the head of Sayyidina Yahya (a).
Where is Sayyidina Yahya? What did they do? They said, “We cut his head.” No, he was just taken up and his
clean body left there for people to see and to understand that if a person is clean, no one can give that one
trouble or suffering or misery as they are quickly taken up!
As well for Jesus Christ (a). People said that the Romans caught him and put him on the cross. From the
beginning to its end this is not true, because no one can touch a heavenly being. If all of Mankind came, they
couldn't touch that one. Just a shape looking like Jesus Christ was put before them. Where was Jesus Christ?
He had been taken up, but they were carrying that one and putting him on the cross. They said the Jewish
people crucified Jesus Christ. Never, never! When he was ready to be taken up, there was such a transmission
on his body, a heavenly transmission came and surrendered him. If anyone came to put him on the cross or
to touch him, they just fell back. It is not an honor granted to Jesus Christ (a) by the Christians. The Lord of
Heavens never left His beloved one to be put on a cross. We are not accepting!

That is the difference amongst ourselves and our Christian brothers, and I am leaving the judgment for the
Lord of Heavens whether we are on the right way or Christians are on the right way. Muslims are on the right
way because Islam just informed the honor of Jesus Christ and heavenly defense on him. That is his honor,
but they are not believing what we are saying. If he was not from Mankind, as you are saying and believing, I
don’t think that the Lord of Heavens would leave His beloved one to be crossed. What is this? Yes, they
(Allah's prophets [a]) are running up, taken up, they are clean ones. Dirtiness on those who are not accepting
their cleanliness and never trying to understand between heavenly beings and human nature on Earth. No
one whose body is dirty can step on heavenly stations! Therefore saying, wa theeyaabaka fatahhir, The Lord
of Heavens saying, "You are coming to Me; clean yourself and come to Me." May Allah forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,Subhan Allah
Subhaan Allah, Sultaan Allah 3x
Dome dome dome dome 4x
This is our association that is opening for tonight. It is a special opening coming for our Lord’s Heavenly
Presence; it also belonging to His servants how they should be. His Divine Presence giving so many secrets! O
Man, try to choose one color. It gives you honor when you are reaching to the heavens and the angels say, “O
clean servant, marhaban, marhaban, welcome, welcome to you!”
Dome dome dome dome 4x
O Rabbuna! Anta Hasbuna! Anta Waliyuna! Anta Mawlana, Who makes ways reaching to Your Heavenly
Presence to be easy for ourselves. We like to be clean ones, to not carry the dirtiness of our physical being. We
are asking to be clean ones, when we are reaching to Divine and Heavenly Presence. Forgive us, O our Lord!
(43 minutes) They know it. Three minutes for them who are writing what we can carry, and to correct when I

am speaking my speech to people to give a new understanding about Mankind and about the soul, about their
honors through heavenly levels to make people to wake up and to clean themselves and to be ready for flying
up! May Allah forgive us. Alhamdulillah wa Shukrulillah
(45 minutes) He knows who are listening, and who are keeping. May Allah forgive us for the honor of the
most beloved and most honored one Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Fatihah. What they are giving us we must
say. May Allah forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh happily speaks with Shaykh Hisham on the phone.)
